title: Test Coverage Integration
description:
Add test-aware review capabilities.

## Tools
- **review_test_coverage** - Analyze if tests adequately cover changes
- **suggest_test_cases** - Recommend missing test scenarios
- **generate_tests** - Create unit tests for reviewed code
- **review_test_quality** - Assess test maintainability and reliability

## Research
- CodeRabbit: https://docs.coderabbit.ai/finishing-touches/unit-test-generation
- 'Over 40% of QA teams have adopted AI-powered testing tools with 85% accuracy'
- Qodo: 'roughly 50 developer hours saved per month'

title: Quiet Mode / Severity Filter
description:
Filter out low-priority findings.

## Features
- --quiet flag to suppress info/low findings
- --min-severity to set threshold
- Reduce noise in output
- Focus on actionable issues

title: IDE Integration (VSCode Extension)
description:
VSCode extension for code-council.

## Features
- **Review current file/selection** - Quick reviews from editor
- **Inline annotations** - Show issues directly in editor
- **Quick fixes** - Apply suggestions from editor
- **Review on save** - Automatic background reviews
- **Status bar** - Show review status

## Research
- 'Most leading AI coding assistants offer direct VS Code integration'
- IDE integration is a top-requested feature

title: CI/CD Integration Mode
description:
Enable code-council to run in CI/CD pipelines.

## Features
- **JSON output format** - Machine-readable results for pipelines
- **Exit codes** - Fail builds on critical issues (configurable threshold)
- **Inline annotations** - GitHub/GitLab PR comments format
- **SARIF export** - Standard security results format for GitHub Security tab
- **GitHub Actions integration** - Pre-built workflow template

## Implementation
- Add --output json flag or OUTPUT_FORMAT env var
- Add --fail-on <severity> flag
- Create GitHub Action wrapper
- Document GitLab CI integration

title: Review History & Persistence
description:
Store and retrieve past reviews to reduce context switching.

## Problem
The '3-day code review problem' - developers lose context when returning to old PRs.

## Features
- **Review history storage** - Save past reviews (SQLite or file-based)
- **Review diffs** - Compare what changed between review iterations
- **Resolution tracking** - Mark issues as resolved/acknowledged
- **Review summaries** - Quick summaries of previous feedback
- **Search reviews** - Find past reviews by file, issue type, etc.

## Research
- https://dev.to/bjornbrynjarjonsson/the-3-day-code-review-problem-and-what-its-actually-costing-you-5m8
- '2-4 business days typical review time causes cognitive effort on revisit'

title: Streaming Responses
description:
Real-time streaming of review results.

## Features
- Real-time partial results as models respond
- Progress indicators per model
- Cancel/retry individual model calls
- Timeout handling with partial results

## Benefits
- Better UX for long reviews
- Don't wait for slowest model
- Graceful degradation on failures

title: Caching & Optimization
description:
Performance optimizations for reviews.

## Features
- **Cache repeated reviews** - Same code hash returns cached result
- **Incremental reviews** - Only review changed lines
- **Model selection optimization** - Use cheaper models for simple checks
- **Batch review mode** - Review multiple files efficiently

## Benefits
- Reduced API costs
- Faster feedback loops
- Better resource utilization

title: Asynchronous Collaboration Features
description:
Support async team workflows.

## Features
- Hand off reviews between sessions
- AI maintains context across handoffs
- Tag team members in findings
- Assign findings for follow-up
- Review threads/comments

## Research
- 'Developers can now review teammate code with AI summarizing the logic'
- 'AI copilots function as guardians of context across handoffs'

title: Auto-Generated Documentation
description:
Generate documentation artifacts from code changes.

## Tools
- **generate_changelog** - Create CHANGELOG entries from git history
- **generate_release_notes** - Human-readable release summaries
- **document_changes** - Explain what changed and why
- **update_readme** - Suggest README updates for new features

## Research
- Changeish: https://dev.to/itlackey/changeish-automate-your-changelog-with-ai-45kj
- 'AI changelog generation saves hours and ensures consistency'

title: Repository Context Mode
description:
Address the #1 AI limitation: missing context.

## Features
- **Project-wide analysis** - Understand architecture before reviewing
- **Dependency graph awareness** - Know what code depends on changes
- **Historical context** - Learn from past reviews in the repo
- **Style inference** - Match team coding conventions
- **Multi-file review** - Review entire features spanning multiple files

## Research
- Qodo State of AI Code Quality: https://www.qodo.ai/reports/state-of-ai-code-quality/
- '65% of developers report context as top issue'
- 'Context pain increases with experience: 41% juniors vs 52% seniors'

title: Structured Debates Mode
description:
Enhanced multi-model debate capabilities.

## Features
- **Devil's advocate mode** - One model argues against consensus
- **Specialized roles** - Security expert, performance expert, etc.
- **Round-based debates** - Models refine positions over rounds
- **Synthesis agent** - Summarize debate conclusions

## Research
- Multi-Agent Debate: https://arxiv.org/html/2512.20845
- 'Intrinsic reasoning strength and group diversity are dominant drivers of debate success'
- A-HMAD: 'learned consensus yields 5% more correct answers when agents disagree'

title: PR Workflow Tools
description:
Tools to help with the full PR lifecycle.

## New Tools
- **create_pr_summary** - Generate PR description from code changes
- **review_pr_comments** - Respond to existing PR feedback
- **suggest_reviewers** - Recommend human reviewers based on expertise
- **estimate_complexity** - PR complexity/risk assessment

## Integration
- Works with existing review_git_changes
- GitHub/GitLab API integration
- Links to relevant documentation

title: Review Templates
description:
Pre-defined review configurations.

## Templates
- Quick check (fast, basic issues only)
- Deep dive (thorough, all categories)
- Security audit (security focused)
- Performance review (perf focused)
- Pre-merge (comprehensive)

## Benefits
- Consistent review experiences
- Easy team standardization
- Appropriate depth per situation

title: Review Analytics Dashboard
description:
Provide metrics and insights about reviews.

## Metrics
- **Review statistics** - Issues found, categories, severity distribution
- **Model comparison** - Which models find what types of issues
- **Trend tracking** - Code quality trends over time
- **Team metrics** - Average issues per review, resolution rates

## Output Formats
- JSON/CSV export for external dashboards
- Markdown summary reports
- Integration with LinearB, Graphite Insights

## Research
- Engineering benchmarks: https://graphite.com/guides/github-pr-metrics
- 'PR cycle time, reviewer engagement, comment density, post-review defect rate'

title: Code Health Score
description:
Provide overall code quality score.

## Features
- Code health score (0-100)
- Category breakdown (security, performance, maintainability)
- Comparison to baseline/previous reviews
- Progress tracking across sprints
- Grade system (A-F) alternative

## Benefits
- Quick quality assessment
- Track improvement over time
- Gamification of quality

title: Markdown Export
description:
Export reviews as formatted Markdown.

## Features
- Well-formatted Markdown output
- Collapsible sections per model
- Code blocks with syntax highlighting
- Table of contents for long reviews
- Copy-paste ready for PRs/docs

title: Severity Levels for Findings
description:
Add severity classification to review findings.

## Features
- Critical/High/Medium/Low/Info severity levels
- Configurable thresholds
- Filter output by severity
- Count issues by severity in summary

## Implementation
- Update prompts to request severity
- Parse severity from responses
- Add to output formatting

title: Category Tags for Findings
description:
Categorize findings by type.

## Categories
- Bug
- Security
- Performance
- Style
- Maintainability
- Accessibility
- Documentation

## Benefits
- Filter by category
- Track issues by type over time
- Focus reviews on specific areas

title: Additional Review Types
description:
Expand review capabilities to more domains.

## New Tools
- **review_database** - SQL/NoSQL schema and queries
- **review_infrastructure** - Terraform, CloudFormation, K8s manifests
- **review_api_design** - OpenAPI/GraphQL schema review
- **review_dependencies** - package.json, requirements.txt analysis
- **review_config** - Configuration files review

## Benefits
- Full-stack coverage
- Specialized prompts per domain
- Reuses existing architecture

title: Configurable Review Prompts
description:
Let users customize review focus.

## Features
- Custom system prompts via config file
- Focus area presets (security-focused, perf-focused)
- Team coding standards injection
- Language/framework specific instructions

## Implementation
- Read from .code-council.yaml or similar
- Merge with default prompts
- Document customization options

title: Security-Specialized Review Tool
description:
Add dedicated review_security tool focused on security vulnerabilities.

## Focus Areas
- **OWASP Top 10** - Injection, XSS, CSRF, auth issues
- **Secrets detection** - API keys, passwords, credentials in code
- **Dependency vulnerabilities** - Known CVEs in imports
- **Input validation** - Sanitization gaps
- **Crypto issues** - Weak algorithms, hardcoded secrets

## Additional Features
- CVSS-style severity ratings (Critical/High/Medium/Low)
- Exploitability assessment
- Business impact estimation
- Remediation priority ordering

## Research
- SAST/DAST trends: https://www.ox.security/blog/static-application-security-sast-tools/

title: Consensus & Voting Mechanism
description:
Implement multi-model consensus and voting based on Andrej Karpathy's LLM Council pattern.

## Features
- **Majority voting** - Aggregate responses and show which issues all models agree on (high confidence)
- **Disagreement highlighting** - Surface areas where models disagree (needs human attention)  
- **Weighted consensus** - Learn which models are more reliable for specific domains
- **Confidence scoring** - Show certainty levels for each finding

## Research
- LLM Council: https://www.analyticsvidhya.com/blog/2025/12/llm-council-by-andrej-karpathy/
- NeurIPS 2025: 'Majority Voting alone accounts for most of the performance gains in multi-agent debate systems'

## Implementation Ideas
- Add post-processing step after parallel execution
- Calculate agreement scores across models
- Highlight unanimous findings vs contested ones
- Optional: weighted voting based on model reliability per domain

title: Smart Model Routing
description:
Intelligent routing of reviews to appropriate models.

## Features
- **Route by language** - Python expert model, JS expert, etc.
- **Route by domain** - Frontend, backend, security specialists
- **Cost-aware routing** - Use expensive models only when needed
- **Latency-aware routing** - Fast model for quick checks

## Configuration
- Model profiles with specializations
- Cost/quality trade-off settings
- Fallback chains

title: Actionable Fix Suggestions
description:
Generate actual code fixes, not just identify problems.

## Features
- **Code patch generation** - Generate diffs to fix identified issues
- **One-click apply** - Let users apply suggested fixes directly
- **Alternative implementations** - Offer multiple ways to fix an issue
- **Test generation for fixes** - Generate tests validating the fix works

## Why Important
- Per Qodo research: '65% of developers report AI missing context during refactoring'
- Actionable suggestions bridge the gap between finding and fixing

title: External Tool Integration
description:
Integrate with existing security/quality tools.

## Integrations
- **SAST integration** - Pipe Semgrep/CodeQL results through council
- **Linter integration** - Enhance ESLint/Biome findings with explanations
- **Test runner integration** - Review failing test output
- **Profiler integration** - Review performance data

## Benefits
- Enhance existing tool output with AI context
- Don't replace existing workflows, augment them

title: Mentorship Mode
description:
Educational features for junior developers.

## Features
- **Junior-friendly explanations** - Explain WHY something is an issue
- **Learning resources** - Link to relevant docs/tutorials
- **Progressive disclosure** - Basic vs advanced feedback levels
- **Knowledge transfer** - Document institutional knowledge

## Problem Addressed
- 'AI flags mistakes but rarely explains the why or helps guide less experienced developers'
- Bridge the gap between finding issues and understanding them

title: Model Attribution in Output
description:
Show which model flagged each issue.

## Features
- Tag each finding with source model
- Summary of findings per model
- Identify model strengths/weaknesses
- Compare model agreement

## Benefits
- Transparency in multi-model output
- Help users calibrate trust per model
